_comment: Allowlist for deploy/license_check.py (used by the `licenses` jobs in .gitlab-ci.yml).
Project requirement: only permissive licences. Weak/strong copyleft (LGPL, GPL, AGPL, SSPL, EUPL, CC-BY-SA ...) and unknown licences FAIL the check.
Expressions: 'A OR B' -> one allowed alternative is enough; 'A AND B' and ';' (pip-licenses joins several classifiers with ';') -> all parts must be allowed; '/' is treated like OR.
Names are compared case-insensitively after the 'aliases' mapping was applied.
To accept a single package with an unusual licence add it to 'package_exceptions' WITH a reason (reviewed in the merge request).

A key may be a package name, name@version or an fnmatch pattern; the value is a reason string (any licence accepted) or {"licenses": [...], "reason": "..."} (accepted only while the package reports one of these licences).

GPL/AGPL packages (for example PM4Py, the optional test oracle in backend/pyproject.toml extra 'oracle') must never be installed by the licence jobs: they only install the runtime dependencies and the 'dev' extra.

python._example-package: Reason why this package with licence X is acceptable (reviewed by ...)

node._example-package@1.0.0: Reason why this package with licence X is acceptable (reviewed by ...)

@fontsource-variable/*.reason: SIL Open Font License 1.1 covers the self-hosted font files only (static assets, no code); using and embedding OFL fonts in an application does not put the application under the OFL. Reviewed 2026-10-06.
